summary: Reduces polygon count by percentage, target count, or distance while preserving chosen borders, creases, lengths, and original points.

key_params.name: creases
key_params.note: Use crease or feature edge input

key_params.name: keepedges
key_params.note: Keep boundary edges to avoid cracks

common_gotchas: Feature-edge matching uses point numbers, so copied or rebuilt geometry can break intended crease preservation.
Triangulation can increase polygon count before reduction, making the target count look surprising.
Keep Edges is important when reduced geometry must meet unreduced neighboring geometry without cracks.
key_concepts: Polyreduce SOP simplifies polygonal geometry using percentage, polygon count, or distance-to-object methods.
The second input marks feature edges by point number, not just by spatial coincidence.
The reduction process works on triangular meshes, so input triangulation can change the starting polygon count.
Clean-page weights bias reduction to preserve borders, creases, edge length quality, and original points.
